回到自己的房间，吴姜又将画中女鬼放了出来。

此时，苏婉清激动的心情，已经平复平复了不少，又对着吴姜福了一礼。

“公子大恩大德，小女子无以为报。公子若是不嫌弃，小女子还有一个能力，可以用来报答公子的恩情。”

吴姜挑眉，有些好奇地问道：“哦？什么能力？”

苏婉清的脸颊微微泛红，声音变得更加轻柔，带着几分羞涩，却依旧恭敬地说道：“小女子可以进入公子的梦里，在梦境之中，对公子来说，一切都是真实的，公子可以随心所欲，小女子愿意听从公子的一切吩咐，绝不违抗。”

话音落下，吴姜的心脏猛地一跳，脸上不由自主的泛起一丝红晕，脑海里下意识地浮现出一些旖旎的画面。

吴姜心动不已，要知道，长这么大，他可是连女人的小嘴都没亲过。

眼前的苏婉清，眉眼温婉，气质出众，即便只是女鬼，模样也算得上是绝色。若是能在梦里，和这样一位漂亮有气质的女子“打一场扑克”，体验一番儿女情长，想必会是一件极其美好的事情。

他看着苏婉清羞涩又恭敬的模样，喉结下意识地滚动了一下，心里想着，我是直接答应呢？还是委婉的答应呢？

苏婉清看着吴姜一脸纠结、耳根发红的模样的样子，善解人意的说道：“公子只需上床躺着闭上双眼即可，剩下的事情，交给小女子就好。”

吴姜眨巴了一下眼睛，乖乖的上床躺下，闭上双眼。

苏婉清虽然有些羞涩，但还是大胆的一挥衣袖，身体化为一缕青烟，融入进了吴姜的身体。

不知道过了多久，吴姜重新睁开了双眼，看着眼前的苏婉清，眼中多了一丝不一样的情感。

他偷偷的摸了下裤裆，果然湿了。

吴姜看着同样露出羞涩表情的苏婉清，在心里偷偷的想着，我这到底还算不算处男？

压下心头的旖旎，镇定了一下心神，轻轻的说了一声：“等我一下！”

说完，重新闭上双眼，阴魂瞬间出窍。

一身鬼差制服的吴姜，出现在了苏婉清的面前。

要是没有刚刚的知恩图报，苏婉清看到此刻的吴姜，定然会心生畏惧。

Back in his room, Wu Jiang released the female ghost in the painting again.

At this time, Su Wanqing's excitement had calmed down a lot, and she bowed to Wu Jiangfu again.

"The young master is so kind and virtuous that the little girl can't repay him. If the young master doesn't dislike him, the little girl still has another ability that can be used to repay the kindness of the young master."

Wu Jiang raised his eyebrows and asked curiously: "Oh? What ability?"

Su Wanqing's cheeks turned slightly red, and her voice became softer, a little shy, but she still said respectfully: "The young lady can enter the young master's dream. In the dream, everything is real to the young master. The young master can do whatever he wants. The young lady is willing to obey all the young master's orders and will never disobey."

As the words fell, Wu Jiang's heart jumped suddenly, a blush appeared on his face involuntarily, and some charming pictures subconsciously appeared in his mind.

Wu Jiang's heart was filled with excitement. You must know that in growing up, he had never even kissed a woman's mouth.

The Su Wanqing in front of her had gentle features and an outstanding temperament. Even though she was just a female ghost, she still looked stunning.If I could "play a game of poker" with such a beautiful and temperamental woman in a dream and experience the love between children, it would definitely be an extremely beautiful thing.

He looked at Su Wanqing's shy and respectful look, and his Adam's apple rolled subconsciously, thinking to himself, should I agree directly?Or agree tactfully?

Su Wanqing looked at Wu Jiang's troubled face and red ears, and said considerately: "Young master, you only need to go to bed and lie down and close your eyes. Leave the rest to the little girl."

Wu Jiang blinked, went to bed and lay down obediently, closing his eyes.

Although Su Wanqing was a little shy, she still waved her sleeves boldly, and her body turned into a wisp of smoke and merged into Wu Jiang's body.

I don't know how long it took, but Wu Jiang opened his eyes again and looked at Su Wanqing in front of him, with a different emotion in his eyes.

He secretly touched his crotch, and sure enough, it was wet.

Wu Jiang looked at Su Wanqing, who also had a shy expression, and secretly thought to himself, am I still a virgin?

She suppressed the feeling in her heart, calmed down, and said softly: "Wait for me!"

After saying that, he closed his eyes again, and his ghost left his body instantly.

Wu Jiang, dressed in a ghost uniform, appeared in front of Su Wanqing.

If Su Wanqing hadn't repaid her kindness just now, she would definitely feel afraid when she saw Wu Jiang at this moment.
